//: The import map for the browser bundle, now on the published jsr releases. deltic's wasi package and the polymorph deltic host modules import @deltic/runtime/embedder by bare specifier internally; every package resolving to ONE release means the whole module graph shares one copy, so `instanceof WitError` holds across every boundary. Multiple copies is a real, previously-observed failure mode in this component family (errors stop being recognisable across a module boundary and surface as unbranded throws).

Exact pins, not ranges: the runtime and the translator wasm (which scripts/site-deploy-tree.sh ships from the SAME @deltic release) share a plan format, and a range that drifted one without the other would skew them. Bumps are deliberate: change the pin here and TRANSLATOR_VERSION/TRANSLATOR_SHA256 in site-deploy-tree.sh together.

minimumDependencyAge keeps Deno's default supply-chain gate for everything else while letting these exactly-pinned component-family releases resolve on their publish day (the same convention the polymorph packages' own deno.jsons use).
